title: Dograh v1.49.0 end-of-call webhook body (Buzz payload template)
description: Dograh has no fixed webhook body: it renders the webhook node's payload_template (dograh-payload-template.json) with {{...}} substitution and adds top-level call_disposition if absent (api/tasks/run_integrations.py:426-443). Every substituted value becomes a STRING: null -> "", dict/list -> JSON-encoded string, bool -> "True"/"False" (api/utils/template_renderer.py:248-253). Literal non-string template values (here only `schema`) pass through unchanged. Sent as POST application/json with headers X-Dograh-Delivery-Id (UUID, dedupe key), X-Dograh-Workflow-Run-Id, X-Dograh-Delivery-Attempt, plus the configured credential header (api/tasks/webhook_delivery.py:185-211). At-least-once delivery, up to 5 attempts (api/constants.py:225-230).

call_time.description: workflow_run.created_at.isoformat() (run creation, not call end), e.g. 2026-10-19T10:00:00.123456+00:00

direction.description: initial_context.direction; "" for API-triggered runs that do not set it

hubspot_contact_id.description: Passed in initial_context by the n8n trigger flow; "" for inbound calls

call_status.description: How the call ended, e.g. user_hangup, end_call, voicemail_detected, or telephony status failed/busy/no-answer/canceled/error

call_disposition.description: Raw disposition. Free string, no closed enum in Dograh

call_tags.description: JSON-encoded list of strings (json.dumps), or "" when absent

summary.description: Extraction variable call_summary defined on every Buzz agent. NOT yet redacted

opt_out_requested.description: Extraction variable (boolean) rendered with Python str(). A hint only: the suppression service is the source of truth

transcript_url.description: {BACKEND_API_ENDPOINT}/api/v1/public/download/workflow/{token}/transcript, which 302-redirects to a signed MinIO URL valid for 1 hour. Body is plain text, one line per turn: '[<ISO time>] user: ...' / '[<ISO time>] assistant: ...'. "" if there is no transcript
